pages.title: Legacy API Strategy
pages.content: The legacy API v1 remains during transition. A v2 adapter layer will translate between schemas. Risk: v1 is undocumented and behavior is inconsistent.

pages.title: QA Strategy
pages.content: Manual QA for release sign-off. Automated smoke tests planned but not yet implemented. No performance baseline established.
